title: Leadership Lesson 4: Friends Matter
coreMove: Build enough real mutual knowledge that candor and sacrifice have a relationship to travel through.
sourcePressure: Treats friendship as operational loyalty: people behave differently when known and valued by actual people instead of reduced to roles, metrics, or incentives.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning friendship into favoritism, forced fun, or social softness detached from fairness and honesty.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
